test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

B _ M _ Q _ V M W _ B V M W _ B V _ _ T

options.text: V W V R R M W
V W V R S M R
V W B V S W M
V W B R S M W

solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: B _ M _ Q _ V M W _ B V M W _ B V _ _ T

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) V, W, V, R, R, M, W → B __V__ M __W__ Q / __V__ V M W __R__ / B V M W __R__ / B V __M__ __W__ T

Option 2) V, W, V, R, S, M, R → B __V__ M __W__ Q / __V__ V M W __R__ / B V M W __S__ / B V __M__ __R__ T

Option 3) V, W, B, V, S, W, M → B __V__ M __W__ Q / __B__ V M W __V__ / B V M W __S__ / B V __W__ __M__ T

**Option 4) ****V, W, B, R, S, M, W** → B __V__ M __W__ Q / __B__ V M W __R__ / B V M W __S__ / B V __M__ __W__ T

 
• Q + 1 = R, R + 1 = S, S + 1 = T

Here, 'Option 4' followed a pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
